items.q: Why did Datasite say document parsing is 'all edge cases'?
items.a: Charts, **merged spreadsheet cells**, macro files and layouts break pipelines in **endless** ways.

items.q: How did a pie chart trip up the best vision model?
items.a: The legend's **shade of blue didn't match**; the same data as a **bar chart** worked.

items.q: How much did better parsing improve recall?
Why did Datasite stop building its own parser?
items.a: Engineers were stuck on **support edge cases** a vendor had **already solved**.

items.q: Where should scarce top engineers work?
items.a: On **revenue-generating problems** like graph RAG and agents, not solved layers.

items.q: What does Datasite's RAG pipeline look like?
items.a: **Reducto** parsing, **Turbopuffer** vectors, and **graph RAG** queries on top.
Hundreds of **known-answer questions** over a data room, run on **every change**.

items.q: What bar must the product beat?
items.a: Simply **dropping the files into a frontier lab's projects** feature.
